newsitem.title: UK: Harvey Nash shows modest first day premium.
newsitem.headline: Harvey Nash shows modest first day premium.

text.p: Shares in recruitment services group Harvey Nash plc showed a three percent premium in active trade on their first day of listing on the London Stock Exchange on Thursday.
By 1310 GMT the shares were quoted at 180-1/2p, compared to an issue price of 175p. Around 4.8 million shares had changed hands.
The company raised 17.3 million stg via the flotation, which valued the group at 48.8 million stg.
Harvey Nash, which specialises in information technology recruitment, said it would use the proceeds to fund future growth.
The group has offices in London, Birmingham, Stuttgart and Zurich.
